name: prospero
description: Control your coding agents from your phone. Direct-first with an optional self-hosted E2E relay.

scripts.build:desktop: npm run build -w @prospero/daemon && npm run build -w @prospero/desktop
scripts.typecheck: tsc --build --force packages/protocol packages/windows-native apps/daemon apps/relay apps/mobile && npm run typecheck -w @prospero/desktop
